episodes.instruction: Lift the water-filled mug and hold it upright and steady. Raise the mug 8 to 12 cm above its initial height and hold it there for 1 second, clear of the table. Once it rises by 1 cm, keep its tilt within 8 degrees of upright. Keep the main water volume in the mug. Small scattered droplets are allowed using the same tolerance as Pour By Language: at least 95 percent of effective particles remain inside, with at most 20 percent ignored as small scattered components.
